verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֗ה בְּאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֖י בְּכִסְלֵֽו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·naṯ ’ar·ba‘ lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš ham·me·leḵ hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- zə·ḵar·yāh bə·’ar·bā·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš hat·tə·ši·‘î bə·ḵis·lêw
verses.literal: In the fourth year of King . . . Darius the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month the month of Chislev
verses.literalPt: No quarto ano do rei Dario, veio a palavra de Jeová a Zacarias, no quarto dia do nono mês, que é quisleu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל שַׂר־ אֶ֕צֶר וְרֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֑יו לְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ bêṯ- ’êl śar- ’e·ṣer wə·re·ḡem me·leḵ wa·’ă·nā·šāw lə·ḥal·lō·wṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech along with their men to plead before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ora, os de Betel tinham enviado Sarezer, e Régem-Meleque, e seus homens a suplicar o favor de Jeová

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר אֶל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הַֽאֶבְכֶּה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִשִׁ֔י הִנָּזֵ֕ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּמֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·’el- han·nə·ḇî·’îm lê·mōr ha·’eḇ·keh ba·ḥō·ḏeš ha·ḥă·mi·šî hin·nā·zêr ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî zeh kam·meh šā·nîm
verses.literal: by asking . . . the priests of the house of the LORD of Hosts as well as the prophets . . . Should I weep and fast in the fifth month as I have done these many years
verses.literalPt: e a fazer aos sacerdotes da Casa de Jeová dos Exércitos e aos profetas esta pergunta: Hei de eu chorar com jejum no quinto mês, como o tenho feito por tantos anos?

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová dos Exércitos, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְסָפ֜וֹד בַּחֲמִישִׁ֣י וּבַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְזֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה הֲצ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖נִי אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm lê·mōr kî- ṣam·tem wə·sā·p̄ō·wḏ ba·ḥă·mî·šî ū·ḇaš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·zeh šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh hă·ṣō·wm ṣam·tu·nî ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Ask . . . all the people of the land . . . and the priests . . . When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years was it really for Me that you fasted . . .
verses.literalPt: Fala a todo o povo da terra e aos sacerdotes: Quando jejuastes e pranteastes, no quinto e no sétimo mês, durante estes setenta anos, acaso, foi para mim, realmente para mim que jejuastes?

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְכִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ הֲל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם הַשֹּׁתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯō·ḵə·lū wə·ḵî ṯiš·tū hă·lō·w ’at·tem hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·’at·tem haš·šō·ṯîm
verses.literal: And when you were eating . . . and drinking were you not doing so . . . . . . simply for yourselves
verses.literalPt: Quando comeis e quando bebeis, não sois vós os que comeis e os que bebeis?

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים בִּהְי֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְעָרֶ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְהַנֶּ֥גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer qā·rā Yah·weh bə·yaḏ han·nə·ḇî·’îm hā·ri·šō·nîm bih·yō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim yō·še·ḇeṯ ū·šə·lê·wāh wə·‘ā·re·hā sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā wə·han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não deveis ouvir as palavras que Jeová tem proferido por meio dos profetas anteriores, quando Jerusalém estava habitada e próspera, e as suas cidades circunvizinhas, e o Neguebe, e a Sefelá estavam habitados?

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah saying
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Jeová veio a Zacarias, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ שְׁפֹ֔טוּ וְחֶ֣סֶד וְרַֽחֲמִ֔ים עֲשׂ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lê·mōr miš·paṭ ’ĕ·meṯ šə·p̄ō·ṭū wə·ḥe·seḏ wə·ra·ḥă·mîm ‘ă·śū ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts . . . says Administer true justice Show loving devotion and compassion to one another
verses.literalPt: Assim falou Jeová dos Exércitos: Julgai juízo verdadeiro e mostrai misericórdia e compaixão, cada um para com o seu irmão;

verses.original: וְאַלְמָנָ֧ה וְיָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְעָנִ֖י אַֽל־ תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ וְרָעַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אַֽל־ תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ בִּלְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al·mā·nāh wə·yā·ṯō·wm gêr wə·‘ā·nî ’al- ta·‘ă·šō·qū wə·rā·‘aṯ ’îš ’ā·ḥîw ’al- taḥ·šə·ḇū bil·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless the foreigner or the poor And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another
verses.literalPt: não oprimais a viúva e o órfão, nem o estrangeiro e o pobre; nenhum de vós intente no seu coração o mal contra o seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֔יב וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ כָתֵ֖ף סֹרָ֑רֶת וְאָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ă·nū lə·haq·šîḇ way·yit·tə·nū ḵā·ṯêp̄ sō·rā·reṯ wə·’ā·zə·nê·hem hiḵ·bî·ḏū miš·šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder they stopped up their ears from hearing
verses.literalPt: Mas recusaram atender, e, rebeldes, voltaram a mim as costas, e fecharam os seus ouvidos para não ouvirem.

verses.original: וְלִבָּ֞ם שָׂ֣מוּ שָׁמִ֗יר מִ֠שְּׁמוֹעַ אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בְּרוּח֔וֹ בְּיַ֖ד הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֔וֹל מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lib·bām śā·mū šā·mîr miš·šə·mō·w·a‘ ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh wə·’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·laḥ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·rū·ḥōw bə·yaḏ han·nə·ḇî·’îm hā·ri·šō·nîm way·hî qe·ṣep̄ gā·ḏō·wl mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: They made their hearts like flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Fizeram-se duros como diamante os seus corações, para não ouvirem a lei nem as palavras que Jeová dos Exércitos tinha enviado pelo seu Espírito por intervenção dos profetas anteriores. Portanto, da parte de Jeová dos Exércitos se acendeu grande ira.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י כַאֲשֶׁר־ קָרָ֖א וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·’ă·šer- qā·rā wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū kên yiq·rə·’ū wə·lō ’eš·mā‘ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: And just as I had called and they would not listen so when they called I would not listen says the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Como ele clamou, e eles não quiseram ouvir, assim eles clamarão, e eu não ouvirei, diz Jeová dos Exércitos;

verses.original: וְאֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗ם עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּם וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם מֵֽעֹבֵ֖ר וּמִשָּׁ֑ב וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶֽרֶץ־ חֶמְדָּ֖ה לְשַׁמָּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·sā·‘ă·rêm ‘al kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏā·‘ūm wə·hā·’ā·reṣ nā·šam·māh ’a·ḥă·rê·hem mê·‘ō·ḇêr ū·miš·šāḇ way·yā·śî·mū ’e·reṣ- ḥem·dāh lə·šam·māh
verses.literal: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation
verses.literalPt: mas os espalharei com um turbilhão por entre todas as nações que eles não têm conhecido. Assim, a terra foi desolada atrás deles, de sorte que ninguém passava por ela, nem voltava, pois da terra apetecível fizeram uma desolação.
